A short story about the war rn (It's 1am)

The International Public Representative for the ULR puts his hands on the podium, looking out upon the room seemingly filled to every inch of floor space with news crews. He, somewhat nervous but remaining calm and poised all the same, begins his address to the nation and international community. 

Today, the counsel of the president has decided to deploy a humanitarian force to the conflict zone that is now the Alicia and Capricorn island chain, after the commencement of war between the Empire of Bravanor and Gendarme. This is not intended to intervene with both sides by any means, but to only provide evacuation, food, water, medicine, and other needs to civilians on both sides of the conflict.
    The deployment of these Blue Dove forces and all including naval vessels, aircraft, and other such vehicles will all be marked and will identify as Blue Dove forces, utilizing uniforms, calling codes, and specialised camouflages to make this clear to both sides regardless of language. The ULR is willing to cooperate with both sides to ensure the safety of civilians, if they wish to have such aid in their nations.
    If neither nations are willing to allow such aid into their nations, the ULR will commence sorties to paradrop food and other aid to civilians. If either side intercepts or molests these aircraft in any way that would endanger the crews of those aircraft, it will be considered a direct act of war, if not inspected and confirmed it was a mistake on the aggressors part.

He looks across the room, once again contemplating the cameras, the reporters, all the opinions of those he had just addressed. But as one does, he remains collected and professional

Now, any questions? The second he asks the question, the room erupts with the voices of reporters.
